subject: sociology

moments.title: Gramsci arrested
moments.body: Antonio Gramsci, leader of the Italian Communist Party, is arrested by Mussolini's regime.
moments.takeaway: Theoretical work can be done under imprisonment.

moments.title: Prison Notebooks begun
moments.body: Gramsci begins the notebooks that develop hegemony, organic intellectuals and the war of position.
moments.takeaway: Hegemony reframes domination as substantially consensual.

moments.title: Selections published in English
moments.body: Gramsci enters anglophone cultural studies and political theory via the Selections from the Prison Notebooks.
moments.takeaway: Translation timing determines a thinker's audience.

now.title: Hegemony in cultural studies
now.body: Stuart Hall and Birmingham cultural studies built modern uses of hegemony. The concept is invoked in critiques of media, education and global politics.
now.open_questions: What counts as a counter-hegemonic project in fragmented digital media?

reflection: Gramsci's notebooks were almost lost; their survival and translation reshaped the Western Marxist tradition.
